label: b78
diagnostic_floor: The single-day counterexample holds all lots/debt fixed and clamps signed financing at zero; a full rerun would need changed future account/debt states.
economic_boundary: BIL adjusted-price daily change plus 100 bp/252 is a signed return proxy, not a documented nonnegative broker borrowing APR. A falling BIL quote can produce borrower credit in the paper NAV. Do not label this verified financing revenue or executable borrowing cost.
